question_title: Do you think exploring all industries is a good choice?
question_text_display: Hello! I am still not sure if being a "project manager" is a good fit for me. Currently, I am open to trying out internships in different industries. I want a job that is flexible to work with. Should I pick one industry to explore or should I pick what's available for me? I would love to connect on Linkedin to learn more about your careers.
notes: not excluded: asks for advice on the asker's own situation; the LinkedIn line is a sign-off, not the question; screened by the researcher, round 3
